text: Philip Morris International Inc. is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: PM). Its 2026 proxy statement lists four beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock as of 13 March 2026: The Vanguard Group (8.57%), Capital World Investors (8.17%), Capital International Investors (6.61%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.22%).
short: PMI is NYSE-listed; its holders above 5% are Vanguard, Capital World, Capital International and BlackRock.

source.name: Philip Morris International Inc., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The following table sets forth information regarding persons or groups known to the Company to be beneficial owners of more than 5% of the outstanding common stock as of March 13, 2026
